title: Instar's high-frequency line and low hum
question: Do the reported ~15 kHz and ~60 Hz features appear in the archived Instar recording under a fixed spectrum measurement?
summary: A 15,645.89 Hz line is 39.72 dB above its nearby spectrum and remains prominent in all eight 20-second windows; a separate 59.22 Hz peak is also present.
finding: The pinned Instar MP3 has a persistent high-frequency line at 15,645.89 Hz (+39.72 dB) and a low-band peak at 59.22 Hz (+14.89 dB) under the declared spectral measurement. Neither identifies a watermark, device, location or cipher.
limitations: Only two archived tracks and two frequency bands were measured. Interconnectedness is a comparison recording, not an empty-carrier control. The source did not specify a watermark detector or payload. Decoder and FFT library versions can affect last-place decimal values.
next_steps: For a watermark claim, fix an embedding family, detector and threshold in advance and compare matched audio. The reported time-localized ~500 Hz gaps require their own predeclared intervals and statistic.

scope.representation: Two preserved MP3 carriers decoded to 44.1 kHz stereo float samples; channels averaged.
scope.procedure: Full-track Hann Welch PSD, 65,536-sample windows, 50% overlap; select largest bin in 50–70 Hz and 14–17 kHz; compare to local median; check fixed peak in nonoverlapping 20-second windows.
scope.parameters: Bands 50–70 Hz and 14–17 kHz, local margins 20 and 300 Hz respectively; exclude ±3 Hz around peak; window prominence counts use a 10 dB descriptive cut, not a watermark decision threshold.
scope.exclusions: Watermark extraction, device attribution, recording geography, 500 Hz gap events and LP decryption.

reproduction.environment: Python 3; NumPy 2.5.4, SciPy 1.17.1, soundfile 0.14.0; two original MP3s from reference-data bundle.

visuals.caption: The persistent line in Instar stands out much more than the broad-band peak selected from Interconnectedness.

reader_note: A persistent line near 15.65 kHz is measurable in the archived Instar audio.
reader_limit: A frequency line is not a decoded watermark or evidence of the recording hardware.
scope_summary: Two archived Cicada MP3s · 50–70 Hz and 14–17 kHz.
